defaults.description: Applied to every entry in secrets that does not override the field.

openbaoServer.description: OpenBao API URL. Defaults to the in-cluster active service.

azureStore.description: ClusterSecretStore used by the azurekv provider. Defaults to k8s-shared-vault.

secrets.description: One SecretStore per entry, plus one ExternalSecret per managed secret.

name.description: Names the SecretStore, which is created as <provider>-<name>. For openbao the remote key defaults to <namespace> when name equals the namespace, otherwise <namespace>/<name>; for azurekv it defaults to <name>.

key.description: Remote key to extract for the openbao and azurekv providers, overriding the default derived from name.

managedSecrets.description: Kubernetes secrets to create from this store.

provider.description: Secret backend. openbao reads kv/<key> via kubernetes auth; azurekv extracts a JSON-object secret from the Azure ClusterSecretStore. Defaults to openbao.

namespace.description: Namespace the SecretStore and ExternalSecrets are created in.

labels.description: Labels set on the ExternalSecret and on the secret it creates.

annotations.description: Annotations set on the ExternalSecret and on the secret it creates.

secretName.description: Name of the ExternalSecret and of the secret it creates.

type.description: Type of the created secret, e.g. kubernetes.io/basic-auth. Defaults to Opaque.

template.description: Omit to sync every secret in scope verbatim.

includeAllSecrets.description: Retained for compatibility. All secrets in scope are always fetched; data only controls which keys the created secret exposes.

data.description: Keys of the created secret, mapped to go templates over the fetched secrets, e.g. {{ .FOO }}.
